title: Components
comment: Works inside works: a work with an output is a component; use brings it
into another work, called by name like a circle; every call is a new draw;
small works make bigger ones (the moons and waves on screen are the real
components, 12-components/moon.alea and waves.alea, called by this program).

sections.name: the hook
sections.label: components
stage: let hk1 = text("12  ·  components", x: 0.5, y: 0.74, size: 0.036, font: "mono") * (T >= 3.3)
let hk2 = text("alea, one feature at a time", x: 0.5, y: 0.81, size: 0.03, font: "mono") * (T >= 3.3)
let hookf = max(wave * RED, max(hk1 * INK, hk2 * GREY))

sections.name: output: a work becomes a component
sections.label: output
sections.say: Give a work an output, and it becomes a component.

lines: let moon = circle(x: cx, y: cy, size: size)
output cut(moon, move(moon, x: dx, y: dy))

stage: let g2 = text("moon.alea", x: 0.5, y: 1.14, size: 0.026, font: "mono") * (T >= 11.0)
let s2f = max(k2_code, max(fr2 * RULE, max(moon2 * INK * (T >= 10.45), g2 * GREY)))

sections.name: use: bring it in, call it by name
sections.label: use
sections.say: Use brings it into another work. Call it by name, like a circle.
stage: let g3 = text("night.alea  ·  Moon()", x: 0.5, y: 1.14, size: 0.026, font: "mono") * (T >= 18.6)
let s3f = max(k3_code, max(fr3 * RULE, max(moon3 * INK * (T >= 17.95), g3 * GREY)))

sections.name: every call is a new draw
sections.label: a new draw
sections.say: Every call is a new draw: three moons, each cut its own way.
stage: let m4 = merge(moon4a * (T >= 25.7), moon4b * (T >= 26.2), moon4c * (T >= 26.7))
let g4 = text("three calls, three draws", x: 0.5, y: 1.14, size: 0.026, font: "mono") * (T >= 26.7)
let s4f = max(k4_code, max(fr4 * RULE, max(m4 * INK, g4 * GREY)))

sections.name: small works make bigger ones
sections.label: bigger works
sections.say: Small works make bigger ones: the waves, a word, a moon, in one poster.
stage: let g5 = text("Waves  ·  text  ·  Moon", x: 0.5, y: 1.14, size: 0.026, font: "mono") * (T >= 35.2)
let s5f = max(k5_code, max(fr5 * RULE, g5 * GREY))

sections.name: the end
sections.say: That was the last one. Every picture here was a program, and so is this.

lines: let moon = circle(x: cx, y: cy, size: size)
output cut(moon, move(moon, x: dx, y: dy))

stage: let nsize = 0.2
let nadv = 0.5172 * nsize
let nx0e = 0.5 - 2.5 * nadv
let name2 = text("alea", x: nx0e, y: 0.64, size: nsize, font: "mono", align: "left") * (T >= 43.8)
let ecur = (abs(x - (nx0e + 4.5 * nadv)) < nadv * 0.42) * (abs(y - 0.64) < nsize * 0.4) * blink * (T >= 43.8)
let e1 = text("one feature at a time  ·  12  ·  components", x: 0.5, y: 0.78, size: 0.03, font: "mono") * (T >= 44.3)
let e2 = text("alea.bngz.io", x: 0.5, y: 0.89, size: 0.06, font: "mono") * (T >= 44.8)
let e3 = text("the sound series  ·  on saturdays", x: 0.5, y: 1.02, size: 0.03, font: "mono") * (T >= l6.words[2])
let e4 = text("open source  ·  github.com/sudo-bngz/alea", x: 0.5, y: 1.1, size: 0.026, font: "mono") * (T >= 45.8)
let endf = max(k6_code, max(name2 * INK, max(ecur * RED, max(e1 * INK, max(e2 * RED, max(e3 * GREY, e4 * INK))))))

overlays.paint: paint(max((0.4 + 0.6 * waves5) * word5, moon5 * (T >= 35.7)), palette: "ember", range: [0, 1])
